contract.outcome: For the frozen source-defined top twenty public repositories, attain repository-wide strict compilation after one native automatic fix pass under one fixed assessed compiler, demonstrated by original independent protected native compiler results.
contract.primaryMetric: 100 * compatibleRepositories / eligibleCount, in percent; only complete accepted twenty-repository assessments yield a number.
contract.partialMetric: Known compiling workflows, in workflows; independent valid native results survive unknown full repository compatibility.
contract.counterfactual: Compatible sources count regardless of actor. Removing this workflow and its outputs does not remove the outcome.
contract.historicalInterpretation: The phenomenon predates this contract. No historical reference has yet been reconstructed; unacquired is not unreconstructable. Do not backdate the frozen current source into earlier intent/compiler eras.
contract.comparability: Freeze repository identities and exact compiler/toolchain/environment before outcomes. Retain source inventory counts. Changed star-ranked cohorts or compiler fallback create different comparison eras; snapshots are not additive deliveries.
contract.transformations: One exact native fix --write invocation, including its internal codemod convergence and documented scaffold/cleanup effects; preserve complete original diff and inventories. No manual edits, workflow removal, disabled codemods or reduced validation.
contract.projection: A future independently protected replay can add --json solely to obtain the native ValidationResult array. The decoder checks original stdout/stderr digests, strict command, whole-process status, batch errors, selected-workflow coverage and environment completeness.
contract.authority: The native input ledger has no accepted protected checker source. Arbitrary reports or source pins fail closed. Adding an independent protected producer requires explicit source/receipt review and a versioned contract change.
contract.zeroVersusMissing: Missing native original results, selection, compiler identity or access are null/unknown, never zero incompatibility, a clean result or an assumed twenty observed opportunities.
excludedClaims: Repository repairs delivered by the dry-run migration pass
Savings, synthetic utility weights or invented keep bars
Issue, PR, run, report, cache-write or LLM-evaluation counts as native outcomes

sourceReview.workflow: Complete mission, discovery/ranking, make-build/fallback, clone, inventory, before/fix/after, cache, clustering, issue, no-op and incomplete branches read.
sourceReview.imports: Complete reporting and OTLP imports read; neither imports another file or establishes compile acceptance.
sourceReview.compiled: All 2591 lines reviewed. Activation, agent, conclusion, detection, evals, push_evals_state, safe_outputs and update_cache_memory do not contain an independently protected per-target native compile checker. Compile/fix commands are runtime-loaded agent instructions. Agent-writable cache-memory is uploaded and persisted; upload/job success does not establish the native results.
sourceReview.nativeContract: Complete compilation-process specification, compile arguments/config/orchestrator/pipeline, fix command and codemod registry read. Native batch/process errors, default selection, strict checks, fix convergence/scaffolding and infrastructure-sensitive pin/import resolution are preserved as distinct gates.
